The season started on 4 February and ended on 6 December 2023.{{cite web|url=https://premiumsportsbo.com/fbf-ratifica-para-5-de-febrero-el-inicio-de-la-temporada/|title=FBF ratifica para 5 de febrero el inicio de la temporada|trans-title=FBF ratifies the season's kickoff for 5 February|publisher=Premium|language=es|date=9 January 2023|access-date=13 January 2023}} The competition was suspended at a meeting of the División Profesional's Council on 5 September 2023, along with the [[2023 Copa de la División Profesional]], after the [[Bolivian Football Federation]] president Fernando Costa denounced suspicions of match-fixing, bribery, illegal betting and alterations to [[Video assistant referee|VAR]].{{cite web|url=https://eldeber.com.bo/futbol/amano-de-partidos-las-cuatro-conclusiones-del-consejo-de-la-division-profesional_338884|title=Amaño de partidos: las cuatro conclusiones del Consejo de la División Profesional|trans-title=Match-fixing: the four conclusions of the División Profesional's Council|publisher=[[El Deber]]|language=es|date=5 September 2023|access-date=5 September 2023}}{{cite web|url=https://www.infobae.com/deportes/2023/08/30/escandalo-de-corrupcion-y-arreglo-de-partidos-en-bolivia-podria-suspenderse-el-futbol-por-tiempo-indeterminado/|title=Escándalo de corrupción y arreglo de partidos en Bolivia: podría suspenderse el fútbol por tiempo indeterminado|trans-title=Corruption scandal and match-fixing in Bolivia: football could be suspended indefinitely|publisher=[[Infobae]]|language=es|date=30 August 2023|access-date=5 September 2023}} However, the suspension was lifted per suggestion from Costa on 27 September after reforms to the referee commission were performed and an agreement with [[CONMEBOL]] for monitoring was reached, as well as to allow the FBF's Sports Disciplinary Court to finish the investigations on the matter.{{cite web|url=https://eldeber.com.bo/futbol/los-torneos-de-la-division-profesional-se-reanudaran-a-sugerencia-del-presidente-de-la-fbf_341489|title=Los torneos de la División Profesional se Ready]] on 26 November 2023.{{cite web|url=https://eldeber.com.bo/futbol/the-strongest-es-campeon-tras-emocionante-empate-1-1-con-always-ready_348299|title=The Strongest es campeón tras emocionante empate (1-1) con Always Ready|trans-title=The Strongest are champions after exciting draw (1–1) with Always Ready|publisher=El Deber|language=es|date=26 November 2023|access-date=26 November 2023}} [[Club Bolívar|Bolívar]] were the defending champions. ==Format== On 11 November 2022, the [[Bolivian Football Federation]] announced that the 2023 season of the División Profesional would have 17 teams, as the division's Higher Council decided that no club would be directly relegated to the [[Bolivian Football Regional Leagues]]. With this, the 2022 [[Copa Simón Bolívar (Bolivia)|Copa Simón Bolívar]] earned a direct spot in the top tier, while the runners-up played a promotion/relegation play-off against the last-placed team in the aggregate table, [[Universitario de Sucre]].{{cite web|url=https://www.panamericana.bo/articulo/deportes/division-profesional-tendra-17-equipos-2023/20221111165909007800.html|title=La división profesional tendrá 17 equipos en 2023|trans-title=The professional division will have 17 teams in 2023|publisher=Radio Panamericana|language=es|date=11 November 2022|accessdate=21 November 2022}} The format for the season was confirmed after a meeting of the División Profesional's Council held on 13 January 2023. Teams played two parallel tournaments in the season: a double round-robin league tournament which was played on weekends and crowned the season's only champion and [[2023 Copa de la División Profesional|a league cup]] tournament which was played on weekdays with a group stage and an eight-team knockout stage.{{cite web|url=https://eldeber.com.bo/futbol/como-se-jugara-el-futbol-boliviano-en-2023_310939|title=¿Cómo se jugará el fútbol boliviano en 2023?|trans-title=How will Bolivian football be played in 2023?|publisher=El Deber|language=es|date=13 January 2023|access-date=13 January 2023}} The champions of both tournaments qualified for the [[2024 Copa Libertadores]], whilst the league cup runners-up qualified for the [[2024 Copa Sudamericana]]. The remaining international berths as well as relegation were decided by an aggregate table which considered the performance of teams in both the league tournament and the group stage of the División Profesional cup.{{cite web|url=http://www.fbf.com.bo/d-noticia.php?id=1365|title=CONSEJO DE LA DIVISIÓN PROFESIONAL|trans-title=DIVISIÓN PROFESIONAL'S COUNCIL|publisher=[[Bolivian Football Federation|FBF]]|language=es|date=13 January 2023|access-date=18 January 2023}} The two teams with the lowest average at the end of the season were directly relegated to the regional leagues, while the team with the next lowest average played a relegation play-off series, this in order to return to 16 teams in the league for the following season.{{cite web|url=https://deportetotal.com.bo/que-se-decidio-sobre-los-premios-y-descensos-en-2023/|title=¿Qué se decidió sobre los premios y descensos en 2023?|trans-title=What was decided on prizes and relegations in 2023?|publisher=Deporte Total|language=es|date=13 January 2023|access-date=15 January 2023}} ==Teams== 17 teams competed in the league for the 2023 season, 15 of which took part in 2022. [[C.D. Vaca Díez|Vaca Díez]] took part in the top flight for the first time ever, ensuring their promotion on 24 November 2022 after winning the 2022 Copa Simón Bolívar,{{cite web|url=https://eldeber.com.bo/futbol/vaca-diez-campeon-de-la-copa-simon-bolivar-por-penales-y-logra-el-ascenso-a-la-division-profesional_305121|title=Vaca Díez, campeón de la Copa Simón Bolívar por penales y logra el ascenso a la División Profesional|trans-title=Vaca Díez, Copa Simón Bolívar champions on penalties and achieve promotion to the División Profesional|publisher=El Deber|language=es|date=24 November 2022|access-date=25 November 2022}} whilst [[Libertad Gran Mamoré F.C.|Libertad Gran Mamoré]] were also promoted after winning the [[2022 Bolivian Primera División season#Promotion/relegation play-off|promotion/relegation play-off]] against [[Universitario de Sucre]], who were relegated after one season in the top flight.{{cite web|url=https://premiumsportsbo.com/gran-mamore-del-beni-sube-al-futbol-grande-de-bolivia/|title=Gran Mamoré del Beni sube al fútbol grande de Bolivia|trans-title=Gran Mamoré from Beni rise to Bolivia's top football|publisher=Premium|language=es|date=30 November 2022|access-date=30 November 2022}} ===Stadia and locations=== {{location map+ |Bolivia |float=right |width=450 |caption=Locations of the 2023 División Profesional teams. |places= {{location map~ |Bolivia |lat=-16.516667 |long=-68.166667 |label=
